clues: This city is the capital of a state in India. It sits in the far northeast, near the edge of the land.
Hills all around help keep this place mild in a hot land. Winters are cool and dry, and a hot monsoon brings the rain in summer.
In World War Two, Indian soldiers fought a big battle here for their land. A navy ship was later named to honor those men.
This city is famed for its weaving, and for fine work made by hand in brass and bronze.
Right in this city stand the ruins of an old royal palace and fort. A wide moat of water still rings the place.
